stage_expectations.source: Existing parsing and semantics. Each actual follows the lexical let/Copy/call order and uses one genuine registered unary operand with a typed nonzero literal.
stage_expectations.custody: Individual checked callee/source/operator/result and complete caller/result/world seals. Actual Copy has a fresh value ID mapped to a fresh formal binding and matches the preceding bound value; leaf result and caller initializer match by identity. Definition-time Unknown remains honest.
stage_expectations.negative_identity: Under labelled internal negative instrumentation reject an equal-valued different callee/operation/result and a different retained source. Direct public division/remainder views reject cross-operation or foreign evidence. Accept the genuine graph again after restoration.
stage_expectations.c17: Keep actual C source and observer additions separate. Emit each used leaf declaration once, preserve statement/call order and real / or %, nonzero and target guards. Observe all caller values with GCC/Clang and available ASan/UBSan.
stage_expectations.oom: Reach the newly selected outer node and world seal allocations and the composed emitter staging allocation; preserve context and named/C outputs; check no partial artifact, one hit and pristine retry. Preserve relevant old controls.
stage_expectations.boundary: Flat, straight-line unit caller with one-or-more distinct reachable existing unary leaves and existing Known-only arithmetic. No nested calls in leaves, no new syntax/types/ownership, no public proof/schema and no new state snapshots.
